{{- /*
  Bundled guide-focused documentation export (/llms-full.txt) for LLM clients
  that prefer loading the core LeapMux guides in a single request. Excludes the
  generated per-command CLI reference tree under /docs/reference/commands/ so
  context stays focused on concepts, workflows, administration, and reference
  guides. Uses the shared clean-markdown-body.html partial so shortcode
  conversion stays in sync with /docs/.../index.md.
*/ -}}
# {{ .Site.Title }} — Full Documentation Guides

> {{ .Site.Params.description | default "" }}

This file bundles the core LeapMux documentation guides (Getting Started, Workflow Recipes, Using LeapMux, Administration, and Reference) in a single plain-Markdown document.

- For generated per-command CLI flag tables and examples, open the individual pages under [`/docs/reference/commands/`]({{ "docs/reference/commands/index.md" | absURL }}) or run `leapmux <cmd> --help` locally.
- For machine-readable Hub and Worker configuration keys, storage backends, and all 21 Prometheus metrics (`jq`-queryable JSON), fetch [`/config-reference.json`]({{ "config-reference.json" | absURL }}).
- For the compact or full page index with links to individual Markdown files and Agent Skills, see [`/llms-small.txt`]({{ "llms-small.txt" | absURL }}) or [`/llms.txt`]({{ "llms.txt" | absURL }}).
{{- $docs := site.GetPage "/docs" -}}
{{- if not $docs -}}
  {{- errorf "llms-full.txt: /docs section not found" -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- range $docs.Sections.ByWeight -}}
  {{- template "llms-full-section" . -}}
{{- end }}

---
Site: {{ .Site.BaseURL }}
{{- "\n" -}}

{{- define "llms-full-section" -}}
  {{- if or (eq .Params.llms false) (eq .RelPermalink "/docs/reference/commands/") -}}
    {{- /* Excluded from the guide-focused bundle. */ -}}
  {{- else -}}
    {{- $sectionBody := partial "clean-markdown-body.html" . -}}
    {{- if or (strings.Contains $sectionBody "\n## ") (hasPrefix $sectionBody "## ") -}}
      {{- template "llms-full-entry" (dict "page" . "body" $sectionBody) -}}
    {{- end -}}
    {{- range .Pages.ByWeight -}}
      {{- if ne .Params.llms false -}}
        {{- if .IsSection -}}
          {{- template "llms-full-section" . -}}
        {{- else -}}
          {{- template "llms-full-entry" (dict "page" . "body" (partial "clean-markdown-body.html" .)) -}}
        {{- end -}}
      {{- end -}}
    {{- end -}}
  {{- end -}}
{{- end -}}

{{- define "llms-full-entry" -}}
{{- $page := .page -}}
{{- $body := .body -}}
{{- $url := $page.Permalink -}}{{- with $page.OutputFormats.Get "markdown" -}}{{- $url = .Permalink -}}{{- end }}

---

# {{ $page.Title }}
{{ with $page.Description }}
> {{ . }}
{{ end }}
Source: {{ $url }}

{{ $body }}
{{- end -}}
